notes.title: Demo Major Update on October 10th! Ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] revealed a brand-new demo trailer during [b]Indie Fan Fest showcase (featured by IGN)![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="KGyo-quLCs0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]It’s a huge honor for us to stand alongside so many amazing indie titles—and we couldn’t have made it this far without your support![/p][p]And here’s more good news: the game will join [b]Steam Next Fest (October 13–20)[/b]! [/p][p]To celebrate, we’ll be rolling out an [b]early demo update on October 10th[/b]—giving you the chance to try out the new features ahead of the fest![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]What’s New in the Next Fest Demo?[/h2][h3][b]Class-Exclusive Items[/b][/h3][p]We’ve designed unique items according to each heror’s class, giving you powerful new ways to turn the tide of battle![/p][p]For example, the Chef Doll now brings two very different items to the battle:[/p][list][*][p][b]Furious Slam[/b]: Slam the table at just the right moment to knock all enemies airborne, opening up a chance for your team to strike.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/a816ae610c58b2df8f2e649a610bca7f286ce92f.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Spread Fertilizer[/b]: Spread some “magic fertilizer” on your summons to make them instantly grow bigger— more imposing and with stronger knockback effects![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/fa62fcc36533c8aed1949e33a6391f042d162637.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Turn Your Friends into Toys (Literally!)[/b][/h3][p]Now you can turn your Steam friends into custom toys, using their avatars and profile names.[/p][p]Pick a friend, upload their avatar and name onto the Game Buddy, and watch as your friend becomes one of your playable units![/p][p]Equip your “Friend Toy” with swords, shields, wands, and more, then enhance them further with unique abilities.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/ea094082822049cf0dc3cab509d684a965f8681f.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]New “Poker Series”[/b][/h3][p]The card family is expanding with [b]Spade Card, Club Card, Diamond Card, Heart Card II, and Club Card II[/b]![/p][p]These new members complete the build, creating even more synergy under the “Paper” type. [/p][p]Combined with items like [b]Round Shield[/b] or [b]Magic Wand[/b], they’ll open up new strategies and builds.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/5f4d97c9c78a5c8f8b78e466f8059b86a39f08dc.png"][/img]  [/p][h3][b]In-Game Events![/b][/h3][p]Two events are here to spice up your battles:[/p][list][*][p][b]Joker's Blessing[/b]: Choose from random items to add unpredictability and new strategies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toy Crafting[/b]: Unlock the “Friend-to-Toy” feature right in a match, letting you instantly customize a friend into a playable toy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/d4f9a56e616615a2cedbec1a3c717b14c269b932.png"][/img]    [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Whether it’s a clever strategy, a hilarious moment, or feedback for improvement, we’d love to hear from you! Join our official Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your support! We can’t wait to see you at Steam Next Fest this October. Command your toy army and dive into the ultimate chaotic battle![/p][p]Don’t forget to wishlist [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] on Steam: [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And stay connected with us through our official social media:↓↓↓[/p]

notes.title: Version Update & New Trailer Coming Soon!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share some of our latest updates with you.[/p][p]Our game[b] will be[/b] featured at the [url="https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/indie-fan-fest-fall-2025"]Indie Fan Fest[/url] on [b]September 25[/b]![/p][p]At the event, we’ll reveal a [b]brand-new trailer[/b], including new content such as upcoming [b]gameplay mechanics[/b] and some [b]unique items[/b] (here’s a little spoiler: they’re related to the hero you choose).[/p][p]Meanwhile, the demo is now featured in the[b] XD Publisher Sale[/b][/p][p]! New players can find us on the event page and download the demo for free to experience this chaotic and joyful tabletop battles.[/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/XDPublisherSale2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/XDPublisherSale2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p]You’re also welcome to join our official community, share your feedback, and connect with other players! (You can also find a survey link in the lower left corner of the main menu in the demo.)[/p][list][*][p]Official Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Version 0.1.12 is now live! [b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a Game Rules page, accessible via \[Archive] in the bottom-left corner.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for your support! Don’t forget to add[i] [b]Toy Smash Kaboom![/b] [/i][/p][p]to your wishlist — it’s the best way to encourage us! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay connected with us through our official social media↓↓↓[/p]

notes.content: [p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]After battles, you can now click [b]“View Lineups”[/b] in the bottom-right corner to review both sides’ lineups.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now browse archives of the Summon Shop, Magic Shop, and Weapon Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial can now be rewatched from the Settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved some art assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some music and sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized filtering options when browsing toys in the archive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hamster Ball, Gravity Hamster Ball, Mega Hamster Ball, Screaming Chicken, One Punch Spring, One Punch KO[/b]: Knockback Power is now displayed in the item details panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tank[/b]: Type changed from melee to ranged.[/p][/*][*][p][b]2-Stack Block Warrior, 3-Stack Block Warrior, 4-Stack Block Warrior, 5-Stack Block Warrior[/b]: Added descriptions that higher block count increases the area of their AOE damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Block Warrior[/b]: Physical Vulnerability stacks: 2 → 1.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Blaze[/b] appeared in the Weapon Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Little Hamster [/b]summoned by [b]Hamster Hole[/b] were not affected by the “Enlarge” effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal visual effects for some toys.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where units pulled back by [b]Hot Air Balloon[/b] would not Stun enemies upon landing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some toys in the opponent’s backpack displayed incorrect effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Deathrattle effect would not trigger under the Stun effect.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 10,000 Wishlists！New Toys Unlocked！
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] has surpassed 10,000 wishlists on Steam! [/p][p]For a small team like ours, this marks a truly huge milestone in our development journey. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/9cce0e72f1cc13a4a53416fdceda2936bac7c395.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]From nervously launching our first playtest, to releasing the recent public demo and new trailer — every step along the way we’ve been fueled by your feedback and enthusiasm. [/p][p]Thanks to your support, our demo even made it onto Steam’s [b]“Trending Free”[/b] list, bringing our game to a much wider audience.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re sincerely grateful to everyone who has played, wishlisted, or shared our game. Every single click from you is the driving force that keeps us creating new content and gameplay modes![/p][p]To celebrate this “first achievement”, we’ve added two new military items to the demo — the [b]Mortar[/b] and the [b]Bulldozer[/b]. Grab your friends, check out the new demo, tell us what you think, and don’t forget to wishlist the game! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]As we reach future milestones, we’ll continue to bring more surprises to all of you, our pirme supporters. You’re also welcome to join our official Discord — your creative ideas may even be turned into [b]exclusive toys [/b]in the game! [/p][p]Our official Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Community events are also live now, so come share your Kaboom Toy Collection![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3573070/announcements/detail/505083956845086979"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Here are the details of the update:[/p][p][b]Military Items Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Mortar[/b]: New Addition. Classified as a Ranged unit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bulldozer[/b]: New Addition. Recipe: Toy Car ×2[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tank[/b]: Recipe updated: Toy Car + Mortar, type changed to Ranged Unit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pumpkin Cannon[/b]: Recipe updated: Mortar + Pumpkin.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/078f6876e5c9c3b620ee65140b9bdd70776a7f74.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Optimizations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Matching logic has improved to reduce the chance of facing the same opponent repeatedly.[/p][/*][*][p]The scoring system has improved. Scores are now based on wins and your current rank, with scores for 10 wins greatly increased and scores for the first 3 wins reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to disable combine prompts in settings to prevent misclick. Combine is still available via the details panel.[/p][/*][*][p]You can preview the slot size and shape of the toys in the recipe details panel.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Burrowing Mole / Mole Specialist[/b]: Updated skill description; skill now grants +1 Knockback for each enemy burrowed through.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pencil Cannon[/b]: Slot size: 4→6.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Giant Cactus[/b]: Cooldown: 8s → 10s.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunderstorm[/b]: Special effect updated: 25% chance to apply 1 stack of Electrified.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lightning Wand[/b]: Cooldown 5s → 6s; Special effect: Physical Vulnerability → Electrified.[/p][/*][*][p][b]B.A.N.D.I.T.[/b]: No longer interrupted by other B.A.N.D.I.T. upon entry; type changed to Ranged unit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eraser & Pencil Brothers, Dark Cookie, Gingerbread Kid, Pumpkin Warrior, Nameless Knight, One Punch Spring, One Punch KO[/b]: Knockback reduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swordsman, Pumpkin Warrior, Nameless Knight[/b]: Knockback RES increased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spicy Chili[/b]: Rage 5 → 4, Burn 3 → 2.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chili Fried Rice[/b]: Rage 7 → 6, Burn 6 → 4, Heal 6 → 4.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Marbles, Angry Marble, Rainbow Marble[/b]: Cooldown 0.75s → 0.5s.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magic Wand[/b]: Cooldown 2s → 2.5s.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Little Lightning[/b]: Cooldown 3s → 4s, DMG 3 → 4.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power of Thunder[/b]: Cooldown 6s → 8s, Electrified chance 25% → 30%, Electrified 3 → 5.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Piggy Bank[/b]: Effect changed to +1 Gold per kill, max 6.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Midas Touch[/b]: Effect changed to +2 Gold per kill, max 10.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pumpkin Cookie[/b]: Heal 5 → 4.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Golden Sword[/b]: Temporarily Disabled.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blaze:[/b] Type changed: Weapon → Magic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Icicle:[/b] Reduced Thorns stacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Paper Plane & Paper Plane Legion:[/b] Added Shield Break effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pen Holder Cannon:[/b] Increased HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Peapod Shooter:[/b] Increased ATK and HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Giant Cactus:[/b] Reduced HP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Jack:[/b] Reduced ATK, increased HP.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where resolution settings could behave unexpectedly on first game launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some hotkeys were still active during the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where incorrect items could appear in the Weapon Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Flying Kangaroo[/b] and [b]Kangaroo No.2[/b] units could fly abnormally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trigger priority for [b]Polarity Shift[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with double DMG; DMG now +50% after 50s in battle.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Stay connected with us through our official social media↓↓↓[/p]

notes.title: First Look at Our Development Roadmap!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and feedback on the demo version of [b][i]Toy Smash Kaboom[/i][/b][i]![/i][/p][p]You might be curious, aside from more funny and whimsical toys, what new experiences will the full release offer compared to the demo?[/p][p]We’ve put together a development roadmap, giving you a sneak peek at what’s currently in the works:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/8ce3cf57f31944ed0b3e7129d70485eedb86f2d4.png"][/img][/p][p]From what we’ve planned so far, here’s a taste of what’s coming:[/p][p]The official release version will feature 4 playable characters, each with 2 unique classes offering distinct toy summons and gameplay styles. [/p][p]We also plan to let you [b]turn your friends (and even yourself) into toys![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/d19a6117ba716bf9398299c73be16a08ff515894.gif"][/img][/p][p]Beyond the content outlined in this roadmap, the full launch version will also introduce more storylines.[/p][p]We’ll continue updating the roadmap as development progresses, and we’d love to hear your thoughts after trying the demo![/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to fill out our feedback form here: [url="https://forms.gle/FKe5Hp7NiHYbfGhz8"]https://forms.gle/FKe5Hp7NiHYbfGhz8[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you run into any issues during the demo or want to share with us your ideas, come join our official Discord:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.gg/GfrHR2mn5r[/url] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/870fcbe6a2f4da54092dff17ce5661414f853507.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]And don’t forget to add [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] to your wishlist![/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks again for your support![/p][p]Stay tuned to our official social media for more dev and event updates↓↓↓[/p]

notes.title: Toy Mayhem Unleashed! Demo Now Live!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The first demo of [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] is now live on Steam! [/p][p]Download the demo now and join this chaotic and creative toy battlefield![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743450/Toy_Smash_Kaboom_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]In this chaotic toy world, you can purchase and craft all kinds of imaginative toys, organize them on your table, and fight in a tabletop arena with collisions, traps, and explosive combos.[/p][p]You can also test your builds in asynchronous PvP and challenge other players![/p][p]This demo includes two playable heroes:[/p][list][*][p]Dr.Hamster (Class: Hamster Legion)[/p][/*][*][p]Doll Chef (Class: Super Gardener)[/p][/*][/list][p]You’ll be able to unlock and combine 160+ toys, including brand-new toys never seen in previous playtests![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/28a2ced58688355619b8291b35c2452144b85404.png"][/img][/p][p]Since our previous playtests, we’ve received a lot of amazing feedback. Every suggestion helps us improve. To share your thoughts on this demo, please take a moment to fill out our feedback form: [url="https://forms.gle/HfrY9fYJaNm5gmo67"]https://forms.gle/HfrY9fYJaNm5gmo67[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We will read every response carefully — thank you for your support![/p][p][/p][p]If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to join our official Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]And don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Demo Patch Notes:[/b][/p][p][b]New Items Introduced![/b][/p][list][*][p]Shovel[/p][/*][*][p]Burrowing Mole[/p][/*][*][p]Mole Specialist[/p][/*][*][p]Hamster Air Wing[/p][/*][*][p]Hamster Acrobatic Troupe[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]System Optimizations[/p][list][*][p][b]Improved Matchmaking[/b]: The system now reduces the chances of encountering the same opponent consecutively.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop Refresh Limits[/b]: Magic Shop, Summon Shop, Weapon Shop, and Lizard Shop Gifts now have limited refresh counts, which reset when re-entering. (The basic shop is not affected.)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Temporarily Unavailable in Demo:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sandbag[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Chain Sandbag[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Yarn Ball[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Flaming Yarn Ball[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Joker Card[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]T2 Flaming Note[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments & Optimizations[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Block Warrior[/b]: Attack range now decreases as stack count decreases.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mega Peapod[/b]: New recipe: 2 × Twin Peapod.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magic Lamp[/b]: Now it has 0 weight — easier on your backpack![/p][/*][*][p][b]Hamster Hole[/b]: Summoned Little Hamsters will grow stronger as the match progresses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kangaroo & Kangaroo No.2[/b]: Slightly reduced initial leap height and distance for better control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]B·A·N·D·I·T[/b]: Attack interval reduced from 4s to 3.5s; now stuns enemies upon entry.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Raging Rhino, Rhino No.2, Tank, Toy Car[/b]: Improved knockback effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spirit Scroll[/b]: Demo version description now reflects the true effect (25% trigger chance).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Popcorn & Large Popcorn Box[/b]: Now provide a HP Bonus effect like Rice Grain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Eraser & Pencil Brothers[/b]: Removed permanent ATK buff; now grant a bubble on kill.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Summons[/b]: Now categorized by "Melee"/"Ranged"; “Vanguard” and “Striker” tags removed.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Queen: Attack speed: 3s → 2.5s.[/p][/*][*][p]Hamster Helicopter: Effect: +20% DMG → +2 DMG.[/p][/*][*][p]Thor's Hammer: Base DMG: 12 → 14.[/p][/*][*][p]Chain Paper Plane: Base DMG: 6 → 8; Multicast DMG: 5 → 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Thunderstorm: DMG: 5 → 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Tornado: DMG: 6 → 7.[/p][/*][*][p]TNT Barrel: Burn DMG: 15 → 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Drum & Taiko Drum: Trigger chance: 20% → 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Rice Grain: HP Bonus: 50 → 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Chili Pepper: Rage Stacks: 8 → 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Flame Cloak: HP: 300 → 250.[/p][/*][*][p]Cheese & Ice Cream: Heal Stacks :25 → 20.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rarity Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Polarity Shift: Epic → Legendary[/p][/*][*][p]Pinwheel: Epic → Legendary[/p][/*][*][p]Rainbow Marble: Epic → Legendary[/p][/*][*][p]A Box of Marbles: Rare → Epic[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Stay connected with us through our official social media for future updates and prize events![/p]

notes.title: Playtest Concluded — Thanks for Your Support!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]The Playtest that began on July 22 has now concluded. A big thank you to all the players who joined the test![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/53f71efdabb1ade45303997ea8287343200dd822.png"][/img][/p][p]Over the past week, we’ve received a lot of valuable feedback and suggestions from testers. During the Playtest, we’ve already made some system optimizations and fixed several issues. We’ll continue refining the game including:[/p][list][*][p]Further [b]tweaks to the matchmaking algorithm[/b], reducing the chances of being matched with the same player repeatedly[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to [b]store refresh limits[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More items: introducing brand-new toys[/b],including the introduction of brand-new toys[/p][/*][*][p]Refinements to [b]item synthesis recipe[/b], [b]rarity tiers[/b], [b]stats[/b], and [b]in-game effects[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/7c46c79c2a62e3ab5cfabc1bf23f5926663ab0c1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’re thrilled to see your creativity and how much fun you had in the chaotic tabletop battlefield — it’s what motivates us most as developers. We’ll keep polishing and improving the game to bring you better experience![/p][p]And for those who don’t get into the Playtest this round — or simply can’t get enough — don’t worry! We’re already working on a [b]larger-scale event![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also improving our [b]English localization[/b] and planning to introduce [b]Japanese language support[/b] in future builds.[/p][p][b]Add [i]Toy Smash Kaboom![/i] to your wishlist now![/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay connected with us through our official social media:[/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/FreeParticle_US"]https://x.com/FreeParticle_US[/url][/p][p]YouTube：[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@ToySmashKaboom"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p]——Free Particle Studio[/p]

notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve got some great news — the second Playtest sign-ups for Toy Smash Kaboom are [b]now open[/b]![/p][p]Just head over to our Steam page and hit that “Request Access” button to join the fun. Don’t miss your chance![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/94bbfb1517daa2524213b18e486acb379ddcb121.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Playtest kicks off on [b]July 22 (PDT)[/b], and we’ll be sending out around 300 invites throughout the week. The test will run until [b]July 28 (PDT)[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Need help or want to share feedback? We’d love to hear your thoughts on our official Discord! Our Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p]In this Playtest, you’ll get to try out two classes — from Dr. Hamster and the Chef![/p][p]Get ready to collect and craft over 160 wacky, whimsical toys, and arrange them across your ever-growing desk battlefield. Fights break out on trap-filled, crash-prone desktops —totally chaotic, and creative![/p][p]You’ll also be able to challenge other players in our asynchronous PvP battles, testing your builds against some seriously clever strategies![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/415d99e42030ee46b2c90be60e37257340c3e358.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For returning players, this playtest comes with a number of improvements and new features:[/p][p]【QoL Updates】[/p][list][*][p][b]Post-Battle Damage Stats[/b]: Ever wondered which toy did heavy lifting? Now you can see exactly how much damage each one dealt after every match. Find your true MVP in a snap![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/3b8abde8853d571c88ba4ba1259c73b4dc0d4f29.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Battle Summary & Review[/b]: Now you can check detailed battle records and revisit your unit setup after each round. Perfect for fine-tuning your strategy![/p][/*][*][p][b]Backpack Multi-Selection[/b]: Use drag-to-select to easily manage multiple items at once.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crafting Path Preview[/b]: Just right-click an item in your backpack to see its full crafting recipe — and synthesize directly from the popup. No more recipe memorizing is needed![/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Backpack Slots[/b]: More slots, more possibilities — now you can experiment with even more recipe setups![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]【Content Updates】[/p][list][*][p][b]Clearer Attributes[/b]: knockback and knockback resistance stats are now visible on unit panels.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/9d062ff183d70421e95e08be5b73b520c30f6e24.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance Tweaks[/b]: We’ve adjusted the effects of certain items and added unique skills to some summons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Knockback Visual Update[/b]: We’ve given knockback effects a visual glow-up — they now look even more dramatic and satisfying.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Content Rotation[/b]: Some toys and items have been temporarily removed for testing purposes. We will see them in the full version — maybe with a better presence![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Toys Added[/b]: Welcome our latest recruits — Pumpkin Cookie, Mini Lightning Vial, Lightning Vial and Lightning Sprite Vial — ready to join your desk![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555527/ec5fc89f240a7425e0bde5d90af6c412d3a26759.png"][/img][/p][p][b]For those who don’t get into the Playtest this round — don't worry! [/b]We’re already working on a larger-scale demo event that will open up to many more players soon. Stay tuned![/p][p]Add Toy Smash Kaboom to your wishlist now: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3573070/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]📣 Stay connected with us through our official social media:[/p][p]X：[url="https://x.com/FreeParticle_US"]https://x.com/FreeParticle_US[/url][/p][p]YouTube：[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@ToySmashKaboom"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r"]https://discord.com/invite/GfrHR2mn5r[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Free Particle Studio[/p]
